items.title: Small acts, whole worlds
items.summary: Tea, music, a hand held, the people who keep us going. Small gestures can carry a great deal.
items.alt: A close view of hands offering a warm cup over bread at a worn wooden table.

images.title: Something warm
images.alt: A woman offers a cup to St Clement at a sunlit table, with a child nearby.
images.description: St Clement at the table. Bread, tea, and a little warmth.

images.title: Staying
images.alt: A seated woman holds the hand of an older person resting beneath a blue quilt.
images.description: A bedside moment, after Yi Yi (2000). Staying close when there is nothing you can say to make it all right.

images.title: What remains
images.alt: An older woman sews beside a bright window in a quiet room.

images.title: The door is open
images.alt: A child plays on a tiled floor beside an open doorway leading into sunlight.
images.description: From some of my earliest memories in Пробиштип, with my grandmother.

images.title: One more note
images.alt: A person plays an upright piano in a spare room filled with soft afternoon light.
images.description: A small tribute to Nils Frahm. A few notes, some space between them, and permission to listen.

images.title: The apple stays
images.alt: A fallen apple rests among autumn leaves on a sunlit woodland path.
images.description: Even this will go. A little autumn contemplation, prompted by Ken McLeod's reflections on impermanence.

images.title: A small bow
images.alt: A small child in red kneels beside flowers, incense and a gold-lit household shrine.
images.description: A small bow, offered with the whole body. May whatever goodness grows here find its way to someone else.

images.title: Quiet Company After Lunch
images.alt: An older woman, a child and a man sit around a broad wooden table after lunch, with leafy light coming through an open window.
images.description: Lunch is over, but nobody needs to leave yet. Three people follow their own thoughts in the same patch of afternoon.

images.title: The Room Remembers
images.alt: An older woman sits in a blue chair as figures and memories overlap in an interior of ochre, blue and red.
images.description: Some rooms hold more than one time at once. A departure, a childhood afternoon, someone still sitting where they always sat.

images.title: The Moth
images.alt: A woman crouches beside a tiny moth on a green curtain in an empty rehearsal hall; a large sun prop rests against the far wall.
images.description: The hall is empty, the painted sun put aside. At the edge of the curtain, a tiny moth has someone’s whole attention.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: We all need a little care. A warm cup, something to eat, someone who is glad we came.

items.title: Mercy & unlikely company
items.summary: Warmth for the vulnerable, mercy for the difficult. The sacred has room for our ordinary human lives.
items.alt: A robed figure sits with a dark-winged companion on steps overlooking a quiet landscape.

images.title: No need to hide
images.alt: A white-robed figure offers a hand to a seated dark-winged figure on stone steps.
images.description: Bring the shame, the fear, the bits that have not improved. There is still a hand reaching toward you.

images.title: A place beside you
images.alt: A dark-winged figure sitting beside a robed figure who extends an open hand.
images.description: Sit with the troubled one for a while. We can offer company before we know how to help.

images.title: Close enough
images.alt: An icon-like painting of two adults and a child resting close together against gold.
images.description: The sacred can bear the weight of a child and our need for warmth. We do not have to become less human to come close.

images.title: Held
images.alt: An icon-like family embrace, with a child nestled between two haloed adults.
images.description: The living God, here in an embrace. Affection, need and sorrow belong within the sacred too.

images.title: Room at the table
images.alt: People share supper at a long outdoor table beside a church overlooking Ohrid at dusk.
images.description: Communion in Christ, over supper in Ohrid. Bread, friends, evening light. Pass something good along.

images.title: Three around a flame
images.alt: Three veiled figures gather around a small fire; two look at glowing phones while the middle figure holds their head.
images.description: The Holy Trinity in crisis: together around the fire, elsewhere on our phones. Can we find our way back to one another?

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: Mercy for the one we would rather leave out. Including, perhaps, a part of ourselves.

items.title: Light, dreams & other detours
items.summary: Compassion taking a visible form, beauty we cannot keep, and room for mystery.
items.alt: A luminous woman in white seated among lotus flowers by a lake at sunset.

images.title: Here, take my hand
images.alt: Tara beside a lake reaches towards the viewer, with mountains and sunset behind her.
images.description: Tara’s compassionate embrace, open to all beings.

images.title: A little light
images.alt: A woman in white emerges through soft golden light, flowers and pale painterly colour.
images.description: A glimpse of gentleness, almost too bright to hold. Perhaps we can let it touch us without trying to keep it.

images.title: The whole world, for a moment
images.alt: A softly painted adult and child embrace amid warm pink, gold and violet brushwork.
images.description: Being close to someone in their pain, without needing it to end on our timetable. Sometimes care is this quiet.

images.title: Deep in the glowing heart
images.alt: Golden sunbeams fall through a lush forest onto a bright carpet of flowers.
images.description: Where words fall silent.

images.title: After the noise
images.alt: An enormous mechanical hand and weathered figure resting in water beside a ruined city.
images.description: Inspired by the Zen saying: “Gain is delusion; loss is enlightenment.”

images.title: Endless Robes
images.alt: Pale woodland spirits in moth-patterned robes stand among dark roots and branches; a central figure holds a small round mirror.
images.description: Robes trail into roots; hair becomes branches. The woodland spirits seem to have been here long enough to become part of the forest.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: White Tara: practising a tenderness that leaves no part of us outside. May it become something we can offer to others.

items.title: Earlier wanderings
items.summary: Earlier visits to the shared imagination: quiet presences, improbable forests, and tea with unusual company.
items.alt: A flowing robed figure holds a teacup below a floating teapot, surrounded by luminous winged creatures in a lush forest.
items.credit: 无为茶会 — 2026 (Claude + Midjourney + GPT + GPT Image 2.5)

images.title: Luminous
images.alt: A solitary seated figure glows warmly in a dark painterly space.
images.description: A little warmth in the dark. Something to sit with, without needing much to happen.

images.title: Holy Trinity Reimagined
images.alt: Three veiled figures gather around a radiant fire in a dark sacred setting.
images.description: Three gathered around a shared fire. An image of communion: keeping a little warmth alive between us.

images.title: Take it easy dude, but take it
images.alt: A seated figure rests in a luminous forest clearing framed by towering trees.
images.credit: Take it easy dude, but take it, 2025 · Midjourney v7
images.description: Take it easy, but take it. There is room to relax and still care about what we are doing here.

images.title: The primacy of being
images.alt: A white-robed figure stands in a moonlit, mist-filled forest.
images.credit: The primacy of being, 2025 · Midjourney v7
images.description: Let the shadows settle in their own time. For a moment, being here is enough.

images.title: Strangefield
images.alt: A pastel surreal landscape of rolling fields beneath an expansive sky.
images.description: Somewhere in our shared imagination, this place was waiting. I would happily get a little lost here.

images.title: Bloom
images.alt: A kimono-clad figure stands among monumental red spider lilies.
images.description: The flowers have become rather large. A small person can still feel quite at home among them.

images.title: Untitled
images.alt: A figure in purple stands within a neon floral dreamscape.
images.description: A colourful little detour through the imagination. I have not found a name for it, and that seems fine.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: A mystical tea ritual with what I hope are friendly creatures. The imagination has some very unusual hospitality.
